why_ai: Stocking, cutting and delivering wire and gear and serving contractors at the counter stay physical and relationship-based, though quoting and order entry automate.
why_clarity: Orders and fill rates are checkable, but project quotes rarely learn whether they won and quoting judgement is tacit.
why_digital: Bid documents and orders arrive digitally, but the product is physical goods delivered from local branches to contractors who buy by relationship.

why_ai: Contractors stay with the distributor that wins them bids and keeps jobs supplied, a relationship plus physical logistics that AI assists rather than replaces.
why_clarity: Quotes and deliveries are defined, but every job differs and win or loss is learned late or never.
why_digital: Plans, specs and quotes are digital; the deliverable is gear and material on a jobsite, sold through regional contractor relationships.

why_ai: Contractors ask for good quoters by name, but drawing extraction and quote assembly are exactly what document models now do.
why_clarity: A complete, compliant quote is checkable, but completeness judgement is tacit and the win label is usually missing.
why_digital: Bid packages in, priced quotes out, entirely on screen, sold through contractor relationships in a region.

why_ai: Expediting and staging keep some hands-on coordination, while status collection and slip forecasting automate.
why_clarity: A ship date holds or slips on a known day, and the same tracking recurs on every order, though causes are opaque.
why_digital: Acknowledgements and portal data are digital; the outcome is gear physically arriving on site for a local contractor.

why_ai: Storm stock, yards and alliance relationships are physical and trust-based, and grid investment keeps demand durable.
why_clarity: Fill rates under alliance terms are measured, but storm demand is rare and lumpy.
why_digital: Orders flow over EDI, but the product is transformers, cable and hardware delivered to utility yards under negotiated alliances.

why_ai: Matching invoice lines to agreements and working reason codes is rule-bound document work that agents can do.
why_clarity: Each claim line is paid or rejected with a code, thousands of times a month.
why_digital: Agreements, invoices and EDI claims are all digital; manufacturers and distributors settle remotely.

why_ai: Electricians come in person for parts today, and the counter veteran's recognition and relationships keep it human.
why_clarity: The part fits or it doesn't, immediately, but identification relies on tacit recognition.
why_digital: Physical parts handed over a counter to local contractors who walk in.

why_ai: Local relationships and physical branches protect independents, though chains with better tooling pressure them.
why_clarity: Orders and claims are checkable and recur, but owners run much of the business by habit.
why_digital: Physical goods from one or a few local branches to contractors who know the owner.

why_ai: Decoding catalogue strings and checking them against schedules and specs is document work models handle well.
why_clarity: First-pass approval is a clear target, but rejections arrive weeks later and spec readings vary.
why_digital: Fixture schedules, cut sheets and submittals are documents produced and delivered digitally.

why_ai: Cost-plus pricing on a public copper reference is arithmetic that software performs directly.
why_clarity: Margin at release is exact and known the day the order ships.
why_digital: Copper prices, price sheets and quotes are all data; the decision is made on screen.

why_ai: Ingesting price files and mapping supersessions is data engineering that automates almost completely.
why_clarity: Each item resolves to a current price or not, across thousands of near-identical updates.
why_digital: Manufacturer files in, ERP and webstore records out, entirely digital.

why_ai: Benchmarks referenced in contracts carry accountability for methodology and depend on reporters' trusted contacts, as at the other price agencies, though data feeds compress the routine work.
why_clarity: A published assessment follows a documented methodology every day, with trade evidence checked later.
why_digital: Calls and data in, assessments out, sold to subscribers worldwide.

why_ai: Supply outlooks rest on analyst judgement and survey access, but AI drafts much of the reporting.
why_clarity: Survey methods are documented but forecasts are graded slowly and loosely.
why_digital: Surveys and data in, subscription research out, sold globally.

why_ai: Pricing judgement on contested jobs and rep relationships offer some protection; approvals within rules automate.
why_clarity: SPA approvals recur at volume, but whether a price won the job is rarely known.
why_digital: Requests and claims arrive digitally; pricing is negotiated with reps and distributors in a territory.

why_ai: Members trust the association to hold confidential data, but compiling statistics is routine and automatable.
why_clarity: Shipment statistics follow defined categories and recur monthly.
why_digital: Member data in, reports out, delivered digitally to a fixed membership.

why_ai: Federal rules carry legal authority and contested economic judgement that AI cannot sign.
why_clarity: The rulemaking procedure is codified, but each rule is a multi-year one-off graded by courts and markets.
why_digital: Analysis is digital, but the agency is the only provider and buyer.

why_ai: Underwriting subcontractors is data-driven lending that automates, with some judgement on project risk.
why_clarity: Loans are repaid or not within about 120 days, across many similar cases.
why_digital: Applications, decisions and payments are online, sold to contractors remotely.

why_ai: National-security trade findings are a statutory government act with contested judgement.
why_clarity: Investigations follow statute and procedure, but each is one-off and graded by policy outcomes.
why_digital: Comments and analysis are digital, but there is one actor and no market.

why_ai: Employment-based market estimates and rankings are easy for AI-native tools to reproduce.
why_clarity: Estimates follow a stated method but are rarely graded against actual sales.
why_digital: Data in, articles and tables out, published online.

why_ai: Preparing statutory notices against state deadlines is routine form work that software already does.
why_clarity: A notice is filed correctly and on time or not, under written state rules.
why_digital: Project data in, notices filed and tracked online for remote clients.

why_ai: Counterfeiting is adversarial and physical products must be tested and seized, so the work persists.
why_clarity: Authentication tests are clear, but enforcement priorities and outcomes vary.
why_digital: Starts from physical products and online listings and ends in enforcement actions as well as digital alerts.
